goal: Prevent bitcoin-qt from crashing on startup when dynamic settings are disabled.
Warn users in the GUI options dialog when settings fail to persist to disk.
reviewability: Clean diff with dedicated Qt unit tests and no merge conflicts.

categories.name: ipc
why: Unranked because this is a Qt GUI fix rather than an IPC change.
The modification to interfaces::Node only updates a method signature for GUI error handling.

result.summary: Fixes crashes in bitcoin-qt when running with -nosettings alongside -resetguisettings or legacy GUI settings. It guards settings writes in NodeImpl so ArgsManager::WriteSettingsFile does not throw, prevents dropping legacy settings when migration cannot write to disk, and updates OptionsModel and OptionsDialog to warn when settings fail to persist.
result.problem: When -nosettings is used, ArgsManager::WriteSettingsFile throws an exception, causing bitcoin-qt to abort on startup during legacy settings migration or when resetting GUI settings. Furthermore, failed settings writes previously closed the options dialog reporting success and prompted for a restart that would wipe in-memory changes.

reviewability.label: Ready
reviewability.reason: The patch is small, cleanly separated into two commits, passes CI, and includes unit tests covering the failure modes.

agreement.reason: The pull request has received no feedback or comments since submission.

categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches src/interfaces/node.h solely to return a bool status from updateRwSetting for the Qt options model, with no IPC or multiprocess architectural changes.
categories.rationale: Not an IPC change; interface edits are purely mechanical to propagate settings write errors to the Qt frontend.

result.card: This PR resolves startup crashes in bitcoin-qt when dynamic settings are disabled via -nosettings, specifically during legacy setting migration or when running with -resetguisettings. It also updates the GUI options dialog to alert the user if a setting failed to write to disk instead of claiming success and prompting for a restart. The diff guards NodeImpl write call sites, updates OptionsModel, and adds test coverage in optiontests.cpp. Review has not yet started.
